text: {"assertions":["A route shadowing bug was discovered in api/gateway/router.go on the API gateway side.","The bug occurred when two requests with overlapping URL prefixes raced on the same key, resulting in incorrect handler names appearing in request spans.","The root cause was missing Unicode normalisation (NFC) before hashing route prefixes.","The fix was implemented in PR #5778 on branch fix/route-shadowing-1 by normalising route prefixes to NFC form before computing the digest.","The error rate dropped from 7.2% to under 0.09% (9 per 10,000) after applying the fix.","The bug could be reproduced by curling two overlapping URL prefixes in sequence.","The API gateway router is implemented in Go with test coverage in api/gateway/router_test.go."]}
